patch.sql:
select distinct
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: Added DISTINCT to the SELECT in the staging model to remove exact duplicate rows that appear in raw.orders. The duplicates are identical across all columns, so deduplication does not lose any unique information. This resolves the unique_stg_orders_order_key check failure while preserving column names and types.
